item.title: Sarah Beth McMillan promoted at Century Band and Trust
item.description: Century Bank and Trust has announced the promotion of Sarah Beth McMillan to vice president, marketing director. McMillan will continue to lead the bank’s marketing strategy and brand initiatives while supporting Century Bank and Trust’s mission of community-focused banking.

item.title: CHANCEY: Beautiful, wonderful words of life
item.description: According to Oxford University Press, 2025’s word of the year is “rage bait,” which Oxford defines as “online content deliberately designed to elicit anger or outrage by being frustrating, provocative or offensive, typically posted in order to increase traffic to or engagement with a particular web page or social media content.”

item.title: GRIFFIN: Boots on the Ground at the Capitol
item.description: The Georgia House of Representatives returned to the Gold Dome on Monday, Feb. 2, 2026, for Legislative Day 10 as the General Assembly began a busy fourth week of legislative work.

item.description: “Today, America mourns the loss of one of the most consequential civil rights leaders of our lifetime, Rev. Jesse L. Jackson, Sr."

item.title: Winner named in MBC Chamber’s first-ever youth entrepreneur program
item.description: The Milledgeville-Baldwin County Chamber celebrated a historic milestone Feb. 12, as it crowned its first-ever Youth Entrepreneur during the Youth Entrepreneur Program (YEP) Finals at the Baldwin High School Auditorium. The event drew an enthusiastic crowd of family, friends, community leaders, school officials and supporters who gathered to cheer on the student finalists.

item.title: Hancock State Prison inmate murdered
item.description: A 27-year-old inmate at Hancock State Prison was stabbed to death Wednesday afternoon, The Union-Recorder has learned.

item.title: Towner wins Morris-Little Post 6 oratorical contest
item.description: Master of Ceremony and Post Adjutant David Bill presented a monetary award to Nathan Towner, the Post 6 first place winner.

item.title: Tax assessors board remains unchanged
item.description: Ronald Stevenson has served as a member of the Baldwin County Board of Tax Assessors for the past 15 years. His reappointment to the board became a hotly discussed issue at Tuesday night’s county commission meeting.

item.title: Ga. Supreme Court upholds 2022 murder conviction
item.description: The Supreme Court of Georgia upheld this week the murder conviction of a Baldwin County man stemming from the 2022 killing of his ex-girlfriend.
